biggest_catch: 30% fee on every seat - and empty classes pay $0, so marketing your listing matters more than your subject.
catches: No bookings = no pay; saturated subjects struggle to fill.
You design your own curriculum - prep time is unpaid.

c1.evidence: support.outschool.com: 'you are paid 70% of the Class Price multiplied by the number of enrolled Learners'; New Teacher FAQ recommends $18-21 per learner per hour.

c2.evidence: support.outschool.com: 'We send payouts to Teachers via PayPal... in the United States Dollar (USD).'

c3.evidence: No upfront fee documented in official terms.

c4.evidence: Numeric 70% payout formula and $18-21/learner/hour recommendation - official.

eligibility: Must reside full-time in the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, England or Wales; background check; class listings reviewed (typically 1-3 business days).
notes: Official: Teacher Earnings and Payments Policy (70% x class price x learners, PayPal USD) and New Teacher FAQ ($18-21/learner/hour recommendation).
payout_quote: Official Teacher Earnings and Payments Policy: 'We send payouts to Teachers via PayPal. For each section, you are paid 70% of the Class Price multiplied by the number of enrolled Learners.' Teachers set their own class prices (Outschool recommends $18-21 per learner per hour); Outschool reports average teacher earnings of ~$50/hour when classes fill.
steps: Apply to teach on outschool.com (background check required).
Create a class listing (reviewed in 1-3 business days).
Teach live classes via Zoom; parents pay per learner.
Receive 70% of class price x enrolled learners via PayPal.
timing: Official Stripe transition page: recurring weekly classes paid 7 days after the week's first meeting; fixed-length classes paid upfront paid 7-8 days after the section starts; fixed-length paid weekly, 7 days after that week's first meeting; self-paced paid upfront, 7 days after purchase; self-paced paid weekly, 7 days after the first day of that week. (support.outschool.com, Transitioning teacher payouts to Stripe)

repeatable.cadence: repeatable per class section; an empty class pays $0

maximize: Your pay scales with SEATS, not hours: a $20/hr class with 10 kids at 70% is $140/hr - fill big group classes instead of 1:1. Run weekly-recurring sections (subscription billing) so one approved listing pays every week with zero new marketing.
payout_value_note: 70% of recommended $18-$21 per learner per classroom hour (official); per learner-hour
numeric_basis: backfill: payout: 70% of $18-$21/learner/hr official; time: 60min per classroom hour
who_pays: Parents pay per learner. Outschool keeps 30% and sends you 70% of the class price multiplied by the number of enrolled learners.
who_qualifies: Must reside full-time in the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, England or Wales. Background check required; class listings are reviewed, typically within 1-3 business days.
work_available: Not guaranteed - classes only pay when learners enroll; an empty class pays $0, and saturated subjects struggle to fill seats.
what_gets_accepted: Completed classes with enrolled learners. Each section pays 70% of the class price times the number of enrolled learners.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Outschool keeps 30% of every enrollment; no upfront fee. Designing your own curriculum and prepping classes is unpaid. Payouts go out via PayPal in USD.
when_cash_arrives: Per Outschool's official payout schedule: recurring weekly classes pay 7 days after the week's first meeting; fixed-length classes pay 7-8 days after the section starts (weekly-paid options pay 7 days after that week's first meeting); self-paced classes pay 7 days after purchase or after the first day of that week. Payouts go via PayPal in USD.
